description: This file contains PHP functions related to AJAX endpoints for upgrade and system check procedures in SuiteCRM. It handles upgrade progress updates, post-install tasks, SQL schema checking, file permission checks, and user notifications during the upgrade process.

methods.name: ajaxSqlProgress
methods.description: Displays progress of SQL queries during upgrade process and updates persistence state.

methods.name: commitAjaxFinalTouches
methods.description: Performs final upgrade steps including rebuilding cache, registering upgrade, and sending reminders.

methods.name: commitAjaxRunSql
methods.description: Executes a single SQL statement during the upgrade, handling errors and progress reporting.

methods.name: commitAjaxGetSqlErrors
methods.description: Returns collected SQL errors encountered during upgrade.

methods.name: commitAjaxPrepSchemaCheck
methods.description: Prepares SQL schema check by loading schema validation scripts.

methods.name: commitAjaxPostInstall
methods.description: Performs post-installation tasks such as updating version info, executing post-install scripts, and rebuilding configuration.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonFindUpgradeFiles
methods.description: Identifies upgrade files in the uploaded zip archive, extracts manifest, and prepares file lists.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonDiffFiles
methods.description: Verifies MD5 sums of files to detect differences, identifying files needing manual merge during upgrade.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonGetDiff
methods.description: Displays differences between current files and upgrade files, allowing user to select overwrite options.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonPrepSchemaCheck
methods.description: Loads SQL scripts for schema verification before upgrade.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonSchemaCheck
methods.description: Verifies individual SQL statements in schema change scripts.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonGetSchemaErrors
methods.description: Reports schema validation errors encountered during preflight.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonFillSchema
methods.description: Displays SQL scripts for review before execution.

methods.name: systemCheckJsonGetFiles
methods.description: Lists files and directories for permission checks.

methods.name: systemCheckJsonCheckFiles
methods.description: Checks file permissions and ownership, reports issues.
